#!/bin/bash
# Acquire the real target: cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 12.6.68-1 (CUDA 12.6U1, affected) vs 12.6.77-1 (CUDA 12.6U2, fixed).
# Verify: InRelease gpgv -> Packages sha256 -> deb sha256 -> dpkg-deb -x -> nvdisasm --version.
set -u
BASE=https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2204/x86_64
KEYRING=/usr/share/keyrings/cuda-archive-keyring.gpg
cd /work
FAIL=0; fail(){ echo "!!! FAIL: $*"; FAIL=1; }
have(){ command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
have curl || { apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null 2>&1; }
have curl || { echo "no curl"; exit 2; }

[ -f InRelease ] || curl -sS -f -O $BASE/InRelease
gpgv --keyring $KEYRING InRelease 2>&1 | tee /tmp/g.log || fail "gpgv"
grep -q 'Good signature from "cudatools' /tmp/g.log || fail "signer"
[ -f Packages ] || curl -sS -f -O $BASE/Packages
CLAIM=$(awk '/^SHA256:/{f=1;next} f&&$3=="Packages"{print $1; exit}' InRelease)
GOT=$(sha256sum Packages | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ -n "$CLAIM" ] && [ "$CLAIM" = "$GOT" ] && echo "PACKAGES SHA256 MATCH ($GOT)" || fail "Packages hash"

echo
for V in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  echo "=========== cuda-nvdisasm-12-6 $V ==========="
  BLOB=$(awk -v v="$V" '$0=="Package: cuda-nvdisasm-12-6"{p=1;buf="";next}
        p&&/^$/{if(buf ~ "Version: "v"\n") printf "%s",buf; p=0; next}
        p{buf=buf $0 "\n"}' Packages)
  [ -z "$BLOB" ] && { fail "no entry $V"; continue; }
  FN=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^Filename:/{print $2}')
  EXP=$(echo "$BLOB" | awk '/^SHA256:/{print $2}')
  curl -sS -f -o "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" "$BASE/$FN" || { fail "dl $V"; continue; }
  GOTD=$(sha256sum "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  echo "index sha256 : $EXP"
  echo "file  sha256 : $GOTD"
  { [ -n "$EXP" ] && [ "$EXP" = "$GOTD" ]; } && echo "DEB SHA256 MATCH" || { fail "hash $V"; continue; }
  rm -rf /tmp/n$V; mkdir -p /tmp/n$V
  dpkg-deb -x "debs/nvdisasm-$V.deb" /tmp/n$V
  SRC=$(find /tmp/n$V -type f -name nvdisasm | head -1)
  echo "payload: $SRC"
  cp "$SRC" "bin-nvdisasm-$V"; chmod +x "bin-nvdisasm-$V"
  echo "-- nvdisasm --version --"; ./bin-nvdisasm-$V --version 2>&1 | head -3
  echo "-- sha256 --"; sha256sum "bin-nvdisasm-$V"
done

echo
echo "=========== baseline cubin via nvcc (image toolchain) ==========="
mkdir -p in
cat > in/k.cu <<'EOF'
__global__ void addk(float* a, const float* b, int n) {
  int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
  if (i < n) a[i] = a[i] * 2.0f + b[i];
}
extern "C" __global__ void copyk(float* d, const float* s) { d[threadIdx.x] = s[threadIdx.x]; }
EOF
nvcc --version | tail -2
for A in sm_75 sm_52; do
  nvcc -arch=$A -cubin -o in/base_$A.cubin in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built in/base_$A.cubin"
done
nvcc -arch=sm_75 -fatbin -o in/base_sm_75.fatbin in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built fatbin"
nvcc -arch=sm_75 -c -o in/base_sm_75.o in/k.cu 2>&1 && echo "built relocatable .o"
ls -l in/
sha256sum in/*

echo
echo "=========== baseline disassembly on BOTH builds ==========="
for B in 12.6.68-1 12.6.77-1; do
  for F in in/base_sm_75.cubin in/base_sm_52.cubin in/base_sm_75.fatbin; do
    echo "--- nvdisasm $B on $F ---"
    ./bin-nvdisasm-$B "$F" > /tmp/o.txt 2>/tmp/e.txt; RC=$?
    echo "exit=$RC stdout_bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/o.txt) stderr_bytes=$(wc -c </tmp/e.txt)"
    head -3 /tmp/e.txt
  done
done
echo; echo "ACQ_FAIL=$FAIL"
exit $FAIL

#!/bin/bash
# Locate the CVE-2024-0124 patch region by diffing affected vs fixed nvdisasm.
set -u
cd /work
A=bin-nvdisasm-12.6.68-1   # affected (12.6U1)
B=bin-nvdisasm-12.6.77-1   # fixed    (12.6U2)
command -v readelf >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1; apt-get install -y -qq binutils file >/dev/null 2>&1; }

echo "########## 1. file / build id / stripped? ##########"
file $A $B
for f in $A $B; do echo "-- $f"; readelf -n $f 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Build ID|\.note' | head -4; readelf -S $f | grep -cE '^ *\[' ; done

echo
echo "########## 2. differing byte ranges ##########"
cmp -l $A $B > /tmp/cmp.txt 2>&1; echo "cmp exit=$? diffs=$(wc -l </tmp/cmp.txt)"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess
def read(p):
    return open(p,'rb').read()
a=read('/work/bin-nvdisasm-12.6.68-1'); b=read('/work/bin-nvdisasm-12.6.77-1')
print('sizes', len(a), len(b), 'delta', len(b)-len(a))
# common prefix / suffix
n=min(len(a),len(b))
i=0
while i<n and a[i]==b[i]: i+=1
j=0
while j<n-i and a[len(a)-1-j]==b[len(b)-1-j]: j+=1
print('identical prefix bytes:', i)
print('identical suffix bytes:', j)
mid_a=len(a)-i-j; mid_b=len(b)-i-j
print('differing middle: affected=%d fixed=%d bytes, at file offset 0x%x' % (mid_a, mid_b, i))
print()
# per-16-byte-window difference map inside the middle
start=i; end=len(a)-j
step=16
segs=[]
cur=None
for off in range(start,end,step):
    ca=a[off:off+step]; cb=b[off:off+step]
    if ca!=cb:
        if cur is None: cur=[off,off+step]
        else: cur[1]=off+step
    else:
        if cur: segs.append(tuple(cur)); cur=None
if cur: segs.append(tuple(cur))
print('contiguous differing segments (16B granularity):', len(segs))
for s in segs[:80]:
    print('  0x%06x - 0x%06x  (%d bytes)' % (s[0], s[1], s[1]-s[0]))
EOF

echo
echo "########## 3. section layout: map offsets to sections ##########"
for f in $A $B; do
  echo "--- $f ---"
  readelf -SW $f | awk 'NR>4 && $2 ~ /^\./ {printf "%-22s addr=0x%-8s off=0x%-8s size=0x%s\n", $2, $4, $5, $6}' | grep -vE '^\s*$' | head -40
done

echo
echo "########## 4. string table delta (new/removed messages) ##########"
strings -a -n 6 $A | sort -u > /tmp/sa.txt
strings -a -n 6 $B | sort -u > /tmp/sb.txt
echo "--- present only in FIXED (candidate new diagnostics) ---"
comm -13 /tmp/sa.txt /tmp/sb.txt | grep -viE '^(gcc|GCC|GLIBC)' | head -40
echo "--- present only in AFFECTED (removed) ---"
comm -23 /tmp/sa.txt /tmp/sb.txt | grep -viE '^(gcc|GCC|GLIBC)' | head -40
